english: Let $P$ be a point on the ellipse $4x^{2}+9y^{2}=36$ lying in the first quadrant. The tangent to the ellipse at $P$ meets the $x$-axis at $A$ and the $y$-axis at $B$. Let $O$ be the origin. Then the minimum value of $2\,OA+3\,OB$ is
hindi: माना कि दीर्घवृत्त $4x^{2}+9y^{2}=36$ पर प्रथम चतुर्थांश में स्थित एक बिन्दु $P$ है। $P$ पर दीर्घवृत्त की स्पर्श रेखा $x$-अक्ष को $A$ पर तथा $y$-अक्ष को $B$ पर मिलती है। माना $O$ मूलबिन्दु है। तब $2\,OA+3\,OB$ का न्यूनतम मान है
solution: Both equalities at $\theta=\dfrac{\pi}{4}$, so the minimum is $6\cdot2\sqrt2=12\sqrt2$
solution_full: The ellipse is $\dfrac{x^{2}}{9}+\dfrac{y^{2}}{4}=1$; take $P(3\cos\theta,2\sin\theta)$ with $0<\theta<\dfrac{\pi}{2}$ (first quadrant).

Both terms are positive, so by AM-GM $\sec\theta+\mathrm{cosec}\,\theta\ge2\sqrt{\dfrac{1}{\sin\theta\cos\theta}}=2\sqrt{\dfrac{2}{\sin2\theta}}$, with equality when $\sec\theta=\mathrm{cosec}\,\theta$.
Both equalities hold together at $\theta=\dfrac{\pi}{4}$, i.e. $P\left(\dfrac{3}{\sqrt2},\sqrt2\right)$, where $OA=3\sqrt2$, $OB=2\sqrt2$ and $2\,OA+3\,OB=6\sqrt2+6\sqrt2=12\sqrt2$.
Option (A) comes from stopping at $2\sqrt{\sec\theta\,\mathrm{cosec}\,\theta}\ge2$, (C) from $\sec\theta+\mathrm{cosec}\,\theta\ge4$.
originality_note: New: the weighted intercept sum 2 OA + 3 OB, with weights equal to the swapped semi-axes so that it collapses to 6(sec + cosec), minimised by AM-GM (way 5). Closest known: minimum of OA + OB = a + b or of the area of triangle OAB for tangents of an ellipse. Different because: the weights turn the problem into a two-stage AM-GM (sec + cosec >= 2 sqrt(2/sin 2 theta) >= 2 sqrt 2).
stem_review: Read as a student: every symbol, point and curve introduced, conditions complete, one reading of each sentence; answer recomputed with sympy and unique; answer matches the plan. Checked that the first quadrant excludes the axis points (OA, OB finite) and that the minimum is attained at theta = pi/4. Changed: No change.
key_step: OA = 3 sec theta, OB = 2 cosec theta, then AM-GM twice on sec + cosec.
justification: Routine chain: parametric tangent, intercepts, and a standard AM-GM bound with an equality check; no unfamiliar idea. Comparable to 2024-P1-Q4 (L2), a routine ellipse tangent SCQ.
blueprint_concepts: Arithmetic Mean (AM), Geometric Mean (GM) & AM-GM Inequality: maximising / minimising expressions under a constraint

concept_use.Parametric coordinates for Ellipse: P is taken as (3 cos theta, 2 sin theta) so that the tangent's intercepts are OA = 3 sec theta and OB = 2 cosec theta.
concept_use.Arithmetic Mean (AM), Geometric Mean (GM: AM-GM gives sec theta + cosec theta >= 2 sqrt(2/sin 2 theta) >= 2 sqrt 2, with equality at theta = pi/4, so the minimum is 12 sqrt 2.
